name: DatePicker
description: Date/time picker with single and period selection modes

props.name: type
props.description: Value type. 'hour' renders only an hour selector (no minutes).

props.name: showActions
props.description: Show reset/apply buttons (default true for period)

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: Ignored when type='hour' (no minute column rendered).

props.name: hourFormat
props.description: Hour display format (type='hour' only). '24' shows 0시~23시, '12' shows 오전/오후 1~12시.

props.name: disabledHours
props.description: Hours (0-23) that cannot be selected (type='hour' only). Always uses 24h reference values regardless of hourFormat.

props.name: hourStep
props.description: Step interval for hour options (type='hour' only). e.g., hourStep=2 → 0,2,4,...,22.

props.name: format
props.description: Custom format: y-m-d h:i. Ignored when type='hour' (use hourFormat instead).

props.name: initialCalendar
props.description: Initial calendar display month for left/right calendars. When specified, takes priority over value.date/value.endDate so the calendar opens at the explicitly requested month. CalendarInitial: 'now' | 'prevMonth' | 'nextMonth' | Date

props.name: yearRange
props.description: Year selection range (default: ±100 years from current year, takes priority over minDate/maxDate)

props.name: quickSelect
props.description: Show quick select preset panel with common date ranges (period mode only). Presets: today, yesterday, this week, last week, last 7/30 days, this/last month. Disabled presets based on minDate/maxDate. When quickSelect=true and mode='period', left/right arrow navigation buttons appear around the input. Arrows shift the selected range by the preset unit (e.g., 7 days for weekly) or by the manually selected range size. Arrows are disabled when no range is selected or when shifting would exceed minDate/maxDate.

props.name: portal
props.description: Render dropdown in document.body via Portal (fixes overflow: hidden clipping)

props.name: hideNavArrow
props.description: Hide left/right navigation arrows on input even when quickSelect+period would normally show them. Use when you want quickSelect preset panel but not the range-shifting arrows around the input.

props.name: direction
props.description: Dropdown (calendar) open direction. 'down' opens below the input (default), 'up' opens above, 'auto' flips to 'up' when there isn't enough space below the input.

props.name: onReset
props.description: Callback when reset button is clicked

types.DatePickerValue: { date?: Date, time?: TimeValue, endDate?: Date, endTime?: TimeValue }
types.DateCondition: Date | { from: Date, to: Date } | ((date: Date) => boolean)
